cards.title: Dark Mode
cards.description: A fully implemented dark theme using CSS variables that respects system preferences and persists your choice across sessions.

cards.title: Analytics Dashboard
cards.description: Real-time charts, funnel analysis, retention curves, and exportable reports — all in one place without a third-party tool.
cards.highlight: Every metric that matters, zero external dependencies.

cards.title: Cloud Sync
cards.description: Instant sync across all your devices with conflict resolution, offline queue, and end-to-end encryption built in.

cards.title: Smart Notifications
cards.description: Configurable real-time alerts with digest mode, snooze, priority filtering, and native push on mobile and desktop.
cards.highlight: Only the alerts that actually need your attention.

cards.title: Offline Support
cards.description: Full read and write access when you lose connection. Changes queue locally and sync automatically when you come back online.

cards.title: AI Recommendations
cards.description: A personalization engine that learns your habits and surfaces the most relevant content, tasks, and insights automatically.
cards.highlight: Gets smarter every time you use it.

cards.title: Live Collaboration
cards.description: See cursors, edits, and comments from teammates in real time with presence indicators and conflict-free merging.
cards.highlight: Work together like you are in the same room.

cards.title: Custom Themes
cards.description: Full control over colors, typography, spacing, and border radius with a live visual editor and exportable theme tokens.
cards.highlight: Make it look exactly like your brand.

cards.title: Role-Based Permissions
cards.description: Granular access control down to individual fields. Define custom roles, inherit permissions, and audit every change.
cards.highlight: The right people see exactly the right things.

cards.title: Instant Search
cards.description: Full-text search across every record, file, and comment with fuzzy matching, filters, and results in under 50ms.

cards.title: Version History
cards.description: Every change is recorded. Browse the full history of any document, compare diffs, and restore any previous state instantly.

cards.title: API & Webhooks
cards.description: A fully documented REST and GraphQL API with webhook support, SDKs in five languages, and a built-in request sandbox.
cards.highlight: Build anything on top of our platform.
